body.value: Whan that Aprill with his shoures soote / The droghte of March hath perced to the roote, / And bathed every veyne in swich licour / Of which vertu engendred is the flour... (When April with his sweet showers / Has pierced the drought of March to the root, / And bathed every vein in such liquid / From which strength the flower is engendered...)
